primary_studies.title: Tutt et al. Carboplatin in BRCA1/2-mutated and triple-negative breast cancer BRCAness subgroups: the TNT Trial. Nature Medicine 2018;24:628–637
primary_studies.design: Randomised phaseIII, open label, 376 patients;188 per arm; primary endpoint objective response.
primary_studies.population: Advanced measurable TNBC unsuitable for local therapy, or germlineBRCA1/2-mutated breast cancer irrespective of ER/PgR/HER2 if otherwise eligible.
primary_studies.experimental: Single-agent carboplatin AUC6 IV Day1 every21days;6cycles, with up to2additional cycles for responding/tolerating patients under local policy.
primary_studies.comparator: Docetaxel100mg/m² IV Day1 every21days; same planned course.
primary_studies.crossover: Alternative trial treatment offered at progression or earlier discontinuation for toxicity.

orr.interpretation: No superiority of carboplatin in the unselected study population.

pfs.interpretation: No statistically significant difference in restricted mean PFS; do not claim docetaxel superiority from medians alone.

germline_brca.os: No demonstrated difference; interpretation is affected by planned crossover.

limitations: AUC6 q21 trial, not a q28 trial, not all AUC4–6 doses.
Biomarker subgroup was small; no individual response guarantee or general benefit for every HRD/gene alteration.
BRCA1 methylation, lowBRCA1mRNA and highMyriadHRD score did not identify the same carboplatin advantage; do not equate these with germlineBRCA1/2 evidence.
Advanced setting, not an adjuvant cure or survival estimate.
Comparative outcomes concern docetaxel monotherapy; not carboplatin combinations, modern immunotherapy, PARP inhibitors or antibody–drug conjugates.
Do not assign breast trial outcomes to gynaecology or head-neck indications.
Trial planned duration and scan schedule must not overwrite the NCCP breast until-progression/toxicity course.
Response rate is tumour shrinkage, not survival or cure.

00261.patient_summary: In the TNT study of advanced triple-negative or inherited BRCA1/2-associated breast cancer, carboplatin was active, but did not outperform docetaxel in the full study population. The inherited BRCA1/2 subgroup responded more often to carboplatin. These findings help inform a treatment discussion; they do not predict an individual result.
00261.directness: Exact21-day schedule atAUC6 only; NCCP also permits consultant-selectedAUC4–6.
00261.do_not_claim: An overall survival benefit or universal preference over current alternatives.

00251.patient_summary: Carboplatin has evidence of activity in advanced breast cancer, particularly in a small inherited BRCA1/2 subgroup. The main comparison discussed here used treatment every3weeks, so it does not provide a specific result for this every4weeks schedule.
00251.directness: Indirect schedule evidence. No verified q28 monotherapy trial result assigned.
00251.do_not_claim: TNT percentages or survival as observed outcomes of thisq28 regimen.
